after_ratings_out_of_10.rationale: The revisions preserve all previously checked signs, constants, quantifiers, and discharge distinctions. Explicit one-form definitions, zero-frequency premises, exact Fourier energy, and the block-trace calculation now expose the two central cancellations. The boundary example correctly separates equality of ambient derivatives from intrinsic pullback differentiation.

verdict: A01-A05 are resolved. No remaining mathematical or source-footnote issue found in the reviewed revisions.

resolution_checks.assessment: b_0=1 is now stated. The compressed zero coefficients are correctly P-hat(0)=X*X, Q-hat(0)=Y*Y, and L-hat(0)*=M-hat(0). Positive Fourier coefficients vanish for all compressions. The exact diagonal identity is 4(||P-hat(0)||_HS^2+(1/2) sum_{k>=1}||P-hat(-k)||_HS^2); the factor four and paired tail frequencies are correct.

tau(H)=sum_j|H_j|^2 and q(z)=z match source. d^c u(z)[v]=-Du(z)[iv]/4 has the correct negative sign and denominator four. beta=d^c log tau(G)-m d^c log tau(q) and alpha_t=m d^c log tau(q)+t beta match betaLinear and alphaPath. Homogeneity gives beta_z(iz)=0 and alpha_t,z(iz)=m/2, with rotation invariance supplying d alpha_t(iz,v)=0. No pi or factor-two normalization error introduced.
resolution_checks.footnote_precision: The normalization footnote correctly points to HomogeneousFlux.lean lines 12-13, which define dc, rather than Hessian.lean line 131, which defines tau. HomogeneousDeformation.lean lines 14-101 support the definitions, circle values, and horizontality.

resolution_checks.assessment: eta=(x^2+y^2-1)dx vanishes as an ambient one-form at every point of the unit circle. Its exterior derivative is (2x dx+2y dy) wedge dx=-2y dx wedge dy, nonzero at (0,1). Both pulled-back one-forms are zero, hence their intrinsic exterior derivatives are zero. The prose now explicitly calls neighborhood equality the sufficient condition used by the ambient derivative API.
resolution_checks.verification_kind: Independent elementary calculation and source-interface comparison; the example itself is not claimed as a new Lean proof.

resolution_checks.assessment: For D=[[U,Z*],[Z,V]] positive and J=diag(I,-I), JDJ is positive because J=J*. The real trace of D times JDJ is nonnegative. Block multiplication and trace cyclicity give Re tr(DJDJ)=||U||_HS^2+||V||_HS^2-2||Z||_HS^2, using the Hermiticity of the positive diagonal blocks. The integrated inequality and subsequent gamma<=2 cancellation remain correct.
Broad replaces unusually broad; no unsupported empirical rarity implication remains in this sentence.
